name: Are permits required for walk-in shower installations in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: Are permits required for walk-in shower installations in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Denver and surrounding municipalities like Centennial, Parker, and Greenwood Village, major bathroom remodels involving plumbing relocations, drainage alterations, or electrical circuit updates typically require local building permits. If your walk-in shower replaces an existing fixture without altering supply lines, drains, or structural walls, permit requirements may be simpler. However, expanding your shower or shifting plumbing lines requires code-compliant rough-ins. A local general contractor coordinates proper trades to ensure all plumbing and structural framing pass municipal inspections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are generally required across Denver and nearby cities if your walk-in shower involves moving plumbing, resizing drains, or altering structural framing.
